business.description: IVP Limited manufactures foundry chemicals, polyurethane formulations for footwear, and adhesives for flexible packaging, operating modern manufacturing units at Tarapur and Bengaluru with a combined capacity of 50,000 tonnes per annum.

products.name: Foundry Chemicals
products.note: Portfolio spanning no-bake and shell resins, coatings, and allied consumables for metal casting industry

products.name: Footwear Solutions (Polyurethane Systems)
products.note: Foam solutions tailored for footwear sector across price points, styles, and comfort requirements

products.name: Flexible Packaging Adhesives
products.note: PU laminating adhesives including solvent-less and solvent-based two-component systems, and solvent-less one-component adhesives for food packaging

products.name: Refractory and Insulation Powder Resin
products.note: Composite materials for high strength, low weight, durability; insulation range delivering thermal and acoustic properties

products.name: Manufactured goods
products.note: Sale of manufactured goods: ₹59,335 lakhs (FY2026), ₹53,714 lakhs (FY2025)

products.name: Traded goods
products.note: Sale of traded goods: ₹50 lakhs (FY2026), ₹104 lakhs (FY2025)

plants.location: Tarapur, Maharashtra (12-acre site in MIDC Area)
plants.capacity: Primary production hub for foundry binders, coatings and polyurethane products; part of combined 50,000 metric tonnes annual installed capacity

plants.location: Bengaluru, Karnataka (28-B Kumbalagudu, 1st Phase KIADB Industrial Area)
plants.capacity: Produces foundry coatings for metal casting applications; monthly production capacity of 500 tonnes; part of combined 50,000 metric tonnes annual installed capacity

outlook.statement: Strategic priorities for FY27 and beyond include expansion into value-added products to improve margins, strengthening presence in high-growth markets such as flexible packaging and advanced PU systems, enhancing capacity utilization and operational efficiency, continued focus on import substitution and localisation, and leveraging digital transformation through SAP S/4HANA to enable real-time analytics, improved planning and operational agility.

Global economy projected at 3.0% to 3.1% GDP growth in 2026; India's GDP growth projected at around 6.4% in FY26 and similar trajectory in FY27, supported by domestic consumption, infrastructure spending, and policy measures.
